tasks.label: Kill webhook-receiver.cjs
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*webhook-receiver.cjs*' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Stopping PID $($_.ProcessId)"; Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0

tasks.label: FULL RESTART: kill everything + relaunch dev
tasks.command: Write-Host '--- Killing EnQuote/Electron ---'; Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -like '*electron*' -or $_.ProcessName -like '*EnQuote*' } | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "Stopped $($_.ProcessName) (PID $($_.Id))" } catch { Write-Host "Could not stop PID $($_.Id): $($_.Exception.Message)" } }; Write-Host '--- Killing webhook-receiver.cjs ---'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*webhook-receiver.cjs*' } | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "Stopped PID $($_.ProcessId)" } catch { Write-Host "Could not stop PID $($_.ProcessId): $($_.Exception.Message)" } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Write-Host '--- Starting webhook-receiver.cjs (silent) ---'; Start-Process -FilePath 'node' -ArgumentList 'webhook-receiver.cjs' -WorkingDirectory '${workspaceFolder}' -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput '${workspaceFolder}\webhook-receiver.log' -RedirectStandardError '${workspaceFolder}\webhook-receiver-error.log'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Write-Host '--- Launching npm run desktop:dev ---'; npm run desktop:dev
